Name: Butch Alex Replacements
Author: SillyLittleDyke
Description:
This mod genderbends Alex into a Butch/Masc Women, It changes the ingame sprites looks and tweaks the design a bit. Theres also high-res portraits included, her regular, winter and beach portraits with inspo from Arcane's Art style.

[b][u]Required Mods
[/u][/b]- Portraiture : https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999

[b][u]Optional Mods
[/u][/b]- Alex_Girl Dialogue change : https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/395
  [i]( This mod directly modifies the game by replacing existing XNB's, Recommend to have a backup
  [ PLS READ DESCRIPTION OF MOD!!! ][/i]
[i]  --> I might make one for content patcher when i have the time )[/i]

[b][u]INSTALLATION
[/u]1.[/b] Download and extract the mod file and place it in the mod's folder.

[b]2.[/b] Add Portraiture into the mods folder.

[b]3. [/b]Drag[b] [/b]the Portraits Folder in the Butch Alex mod and Replace the Portraits folder in the Portraiture Mod.

[b]4. OR[/b] alternatively, Go into Portraiture [b]>[/b] Portraits, Create 3 separate folders for each Alex seasonal fits, Go into [CP] Butch Alex Replacements [b]>[/b] Portraits, Drag each portraits into each of the created folders in Portraiture.
